thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: traces-exporter (otel-collector -> honeycomb) experiencing failures, error rate > 40%, possible P1. Please acknowledge.

Elena (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Seeing alerts for dropped spans and increasing exporter queue backpressure.

Ravi (SRE): I can pick this up if you want to hand off, elena. what's the customer impact?

Elena (oncall): traces are not reaching Honeycomb for a subset of clusters in us-west-2. Logs & metrics still flowing. User-facing apps ok, but distributed traces for debugging are absent. Support tickets from 2 customers reporting missing traces.

Tess (platform): cc @Vendor Support (Honeycomb) — can you confirm if there's a known degradation on your side? Also check our token auth usage.

Vendor Support (Honeycomb): Hi team, we've marked an elevated error rate for our ingest endpoint in us-west-2 starting ~30m ago. Engineers investigating. Status page updated: https://status.honeycomb.io/incidents/xyz (note: link for thread).

Ravi (SRE): thanks. On our side otel-collector logs show repeated errors: ``[exporter/honeycomb] failed to send batch: 503 Service Unavailable: upstream overloaded`` and ``write to connection aborted``. Backpressure causing internal queueing, memory rising.

Elena (oncall): mitigation plan ideas: 1) reduce sampling to 0.1 for high-volume services, 2) flip exporter to our fallback (local write + S3 buffer) or 3) temporarily disable span export to honeycomb and rely on metrics/logs. which is least risky?

Ravi (SRE): agree. Prefer fallback that preserves traces for later replay. We have an S3 buffering exporter configured but not enabled everywhere. Quick actions:
- toggle global sampler to lower rate (fast, reversible)
- enable s3-buffering exporter for critical clusters (needs config rollout)
- if vendor ETA > 30m, disable real-time export to avoid queue blowups.

Elena (oncall): I'm going to lower sampler to 0.05 for customer-facing services now. Doing a canary on prod-usw2/a then roll.

ops-bot: deploy started: config-change/sampler-adjustment to service=auth,api,gateway in prod-usw2 by elena.

Elena (oncall): applied on canary, sampler drop looks healthy, memory pressure easing on collector. No more 503s in canary. Rolling to remaining nodes.

Tess (platform): I'm preparing the S3 exporter enablement snippet for clusters without it. Paste for ops to apply:
```
receivers: otlp:
  protocols:
    grpc: {}
exporters:
  honeycomb: 
    api_key: ${HONEYCOMB_KEY}
    endpoint: https://api.honeycomb.io
  s3_buffer: 
    bucket: redwood-trace-backups
    region: us-west-2
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [honeycomb, s3_buffer]
```

Ravi (SRE): note: enabling dual export will double egress, watch cost but acceptable short-term. Also add rate-limiter on s3 export to avoid burst.

Vendor Support (Honeycomb): Update: root cause identified in our gateway fleet causing transient 503s, mitigation rolling now, ETA ~20-30m to restore normal ingest. We'll post when fully resolved. Apologies for the disruption.

Elena (oncall): thanks. We'll keep sampler reduced and enable s3 buffering for the other clusters. If vendor clears in 30m we can revert s3 and sampling.

Tess (platform): I've filed a runbook item to automate fallback to s3_buffer if exporter error rate > 10% for > 5m. Filing follow-up ticket: PLAT-5432.

Ravi (SRE): also adding retrospective action: make s3 exporter an opt-out on new cluster templates, and surface vendor errors into PagerDuty differently (separate page from internal errors).

ops-bot: incident annotated: tag=third-party; vendor=honeycomb; impact=traces-missing; mitigation=sampling-reduction + s3-buffering.

Elena (oncall): handing off to Ravi for next shift. I'm logging out for the day, leave notes in the incident doc.

Ravi (SRE): taking over. Will monitor vendor status and finalize rollback plan once honeycomb confirms healthy.

Vendor Support (Honeycomb): Update: ingest restored in us-west-2, error rate normalizing. Please verify and let us know if you still see rejections.

Ravi (SRE): seeing successful deliveries now, queue drained, no more 503s. I will start rolling sampler back to normal over 15m window and then disable s3 buffering where it was added.

Elena (oncall): thanks all. Impact: partial trace loss window ~35m for some clusters, two customers reported missing traces but no user-facing outages. Postmortem will cover longer-term automation and SLAs with vendor.

Tess (platform): filing postmortem draft, assigning action items (PLAT-5432, PLAT-5433, PLAT-5434) for automation, S3 costs estimation, and vendor SLA review.

ops-bot: incident closed by ravi. reference: incident/1775008765.
